availability_note: GNIRS is offered in all operational modes. This tool models natural-seeing short-blue 111 l/mm non-XD only. The detailed non-LGS target table permits restricted RA 04–06h and 23–01h; NRC's broad summary starts at 06h. Actual dark-time windows are computed independently.
